name: South Australian Current
figure_alt: South Australian Current: about 60 km author-reported local model width at 130 degrees east, Experiment 6, model day 20. Not an observed width or an annual mean width.

measurements.geographic_scope: Local Great Australian Bight section; no whole-route width implied.
measurements.layer: Described surface-current scale; the width statement supplies no fixed depth bounds.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported approximate scale; no paired edges or numerical velocity threshold extracted.
measurements.forcing: Annually averaged climatological wind and full temperature/salinity forcing over bottom topography.
measurements.source_citation: Miller, H. A. (2006), Modeling studies of the coastal/littoral current system off Southern Australia, PhD dissertation, Naval Postgraduate School, December 2006.
measurements.source_locator: Printed p.48 experiment setup, p.49 width description, Figure4.20e on p.233; PDF pages79,80,264 (1-based).
measurements.source_access: Complete 431-page original acquired from NPS Library archive deposit; selected setup, quantity and section figure reviewed. Not all dissertation pages reviewed.
measurements.name: South Australian Current
measurements.range_interpretation: One approximate local model scale; no numerical uncertainty or temporal range reported.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional section at 130°E; displayed zonal velocity is normal to the section.
measurements.time_convention: Elapsed model day 20 in Experiment 6 with annual climatological forcing; not an observed calendar date or an annual mean width.
measurements.extraction_method: Transcribed original prose and checked its experiment setup and Figure4.20e; no edge digitization.

remaining_gates: Acquire original numerical output and paired boundary convention for reproducible boundary extraction.
Obtain compatible dated repeated current boundaries for physical widths and annual ranges.
